mapper.select: select shot_id, project_id, chapter_id, scene_id, shot_no, duration_ms, shot_size, camera_movement, composition_text, action_text, emotion_text, dialogue_json, prompt_context_json, status, version_no from ai_video_shot where shot_id = #{shotId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_shot (project_id, chapter_id, scene_id, shot_no, duration_ms, shot_size, camera_movement, composition_text, action_text, emotion_text, dialogue_json, prompt_context_json, status, version_no, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{sceneId}, #{shotNo}, #{durationMs}, #{shotSize}, #{cameraMovement}, #{compositionText}, #{actionText}, #{emotionText}, #{dialogueJson}, #{promptContextJson}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{createBy}, now())
